thread:
liz: quick sync — i'm drafting a console card for per-route health that needs token-level breakdowns (p50/p95/p99), throughput sparkline, and error-rate. thinking drilldown to kernel selection + batching histograms. thoughts? :eyes:
ajay: love it. need to surface kernel chooser metrics (chosen_kernel, seq_len_bucket, quant_mode) plus batch_size distribution. also KV cache hit/miss % per-route — that changes token latency a lot.
maria: UX Q: default card should show p95 + error rate + rps. drilldown to token waterfall and kernel/hotpath traces. can the waterfall show avg token cost by position?
ajay: yes — we can emit token_latency_slice events: position_bucket (0-15,16-63,64+), kernel, kv_hit, latency_ms. sample at 1% by default to control card cardinality.
sam: alerting needs: p99 > X ms for 5m or error_rate > 1% sustained 10m. we should expose those as toggles on the card so customers can create alerts from the console.
liz: ok. on sampling — 1% may be low for low-traffic routes. add adaptive sampling: min 10 events/min for a route.
ajay: implemented a prototype in runtime agent yesterday. snippet: ```json
{"event":"token_latency_slice","route":"/chat/stream","pos_bucket":"0-15","kernel":"kv-opt-ggml","kv_hit":true,"latency_ms":3.4}
```
we also added kernel_selection_reason tags: "small_seq","quantized_supported","compat_fallback".
perf-bot: new profile uploaded: https://ci.redwood.internal/reports/prof-1747601200.html — shows kernel switch at seq_len 128 causing 30% p95 jump on smaller GPU types.
maria: that's the regression we feared. can console show per-hardware p95 in the rollout view? customers will want to know if Dedicated pools are affected.
ajay: we can surface a breakdown by hw_class label (a100,v100,rtx). need the metrics pipeline to join hw_class to route slices. pipeline cost will go up — recommending pre-aggregation into p50/p95/p99 by (route,hw_class,kernel,day,minute) buckets.
sam: also include recent rollout tag so we can correlate spikes to deploys. deploy-bot could annotate the timeline.
liz: action items: (1) ajay add token_latency_slice + kernel tags to telemetry (due EOD) (2) eng-platform wireframe a card with sparkline + p95 heatmap (maria + liz) (3) eng-sre define default alerts (sam) (4) perf team to triage kernel switch regression (perf-bot referenced). I'll post a quick mock in #design tomorrow. :thumbsup:
ajay: noted — i'll open an RFC and link the pipeline cost estimate.
maria: perfect. one more UX note: expose cache-hit filter so users can toggle "only cache misses" to see cold-path p95.
liz: yep. adding to wireframe list. thanks all! :rocket:
